data.name: Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Digital Eclipse. Reclaim a Future Lost to Machines.

Hello! I'm a solo developer, and this game has been my passion project for the past few years. Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor is a fast-paced, co-op looter shooter set in a dystopian future where rogue AI controls the ruins of a once-great city.

Built with care and a love for chaotic action, this game challenges you and your friends to take back the city, uncover buried tech, and resist the growing grip of a self-aware machine intelligence. Every mission, weapon, and skill tree has been handcrafted with replayability and creativity in mind.

FEATURES

  • Tactical Bullet Hell Combat;
    Fight through waves of deadly enemies in top-down battles filled with projectiles, explosions, and skill-based movement.

  • Play Solo or in Co-op (1–4 Players);
    Join forces online and tackle missions together. Coordinate builds, revive teammates, and survive against overwhelming odds.

  • 5 Distinct Classes with Deep Customization;
    Each class includes three unique skill trees filled with active abilities, passive upgrades, and powerful toggles to tailor your playstyle.

  • 35 Class-Agnostic Weapons with Their Own Upgrade Paths;
    Every weapon has a personality. Equip any class with any weapon, and unlock exclusive actives and passives to turn your arsenal into a build-defining toolkit.

  • Semi-Procedural Missions Across 5 Districts;
    Explore handcrafted levels enhanced with dynamic enemy placements, randomized encounters, and evolving objectives. Each mission blends structure with unpredictability, offering fresh challenges while rewarding strategic map knowledge.

  • Optional Side Missions and Lore Events;
    Take on high-risk contracts for rare rewards and uncover secrets that reveal the truth behind the fall of Nexarion.

  • Persistent Progression and Hub Management;
    Upgrade your weapons, unlock perks, and plan your next mission from the Nexus Hub; your safe zone between battles.

The AI Was Built to Serve. Now It Wants to Replace You.

The world is fading into digital oblivion. Synthex Prime, a self-replicating intelligence, is rewriting reality from within the quantum network. The only way to stop it is to destroy its Assimilation Nodes and bring the fight to the core.

You are the last resistance. The city is burning. And the machines never sleep.

Will you survive the eclipse? Or become part of it?

Thanks for checking out Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor. If anything in this world I’ve created speaks to you; the combat, the story, the style... I’d be truly grateful if you added it to your wishlist or shared it with a friend.

See you in Nexarion.

data.short_description: A rogue-lite co-op bullet hell looter shooter set in a cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through dozens of missions with dynamic layouts, optional challenges, and persistent upgrades. Unlock weapons, skill trees, and stop the rogue AI Synthex Prime from consuming reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB) / AMD RX 570 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super (6GB) / RX 5600 XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features stylized combat with frequent gunfire, explosions, and blood effects as players fight through waves of robotic and cybernetic enemies. While intense, all violence is presented in a sci-fi, arcade-like style without realistic gore or dismemberment.

There is no sexual content, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or any form of abuse depicted in the game.
